entries.reason: golang-jwt/jwt v3.2.2+incompatible has no upstream fix. It is only pulled in by labstack/echo/v4/middleware (package init, deprecated JWT middleware); the backend verifies tokens with golang-jwt/jwt/v5 (already patched) and never calls the v3 parser. govulncheck flags the init-time reachability only.

Next.js: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Image Optimization API when SVG files are used. Fixed only in next >=15.5.28 (Next 15/React 19 migration, #594). EXPOSED: apps/web uses next/image with images.remotePatterns (covers.openlibrary.org, upload/thumb.wikimedia.org), so the Image Optimization API is reachable; apps/admin sets no images config. Accepted temporarily only because there is no production deployment yet; #594 must land (or images.unoptimized be set) before the first production deploy.

Next.js has a Middleware / Proxy bypass in Pages Router applications using i18n. Fixed only in next >=15.5.16 (Next 15/React 19 migration, #594); no fix in the 14.2.x line (14.2.35 is the last). Exposure judged low: no production deployment yet; revisit at expiry.

Dev-server-only advisory (launch-editor: `fs.existsSync()` existence check can be bypassed on Windows). vite 5.4.x is vitest's dev dependency (devDependency of the apps), seen by pnpm audit only through the optional @sentry/cloudflare peer. No vite dev server is run in production and the Next.js build does not use vite. Fix needs vite >=6.4.4 (major bump of vitest); revisit with the toolchain upgrade.
